description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Swarmweaver, adding {C}{C}.
When The Swarmweaver dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Swarmweaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Swarmweaver enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
